title: workaround: /terminal-setup for kitty terminal
body:
This worked for me:

```
cat >> '~.config/kitty/kitty.conf'  <<EOF
# send a newline literal, for claude-cli
map shift+enter send_text all \n
EOF

kill -USR1 $(pgrep kitty)  # reload config
```
author: bukzor

top_comments.author: tmccombs
top_comments.body: That will impact all applications, not just claude.

top_comments.author: bukzor
top_comments.body:
> That will impact all applications, not just claude.

true. but

1. I can't think of any case where shift-enter sends ascii-newline is unwanted behavior
2. this is exactly analogous to the the other fixes bundled under the name of /terminal-setup
